description: This file defines a final class `UserProfileFileFilter` that extends `FileFilter` to filter files with the extension 'xml' specifically for ECU Logger User Profiles within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: UserProfileFileFilter
classes.description: A file filter for recognizing ECU Logger User Profile XML files in a file chooser.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether a given file should be accepted based on the filter criteria.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the file filter.
